author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Retroid Pocket 6 is another stellar handheld with an excellent price-to-performance ratio.  Let's go over all of its features and discuss why this ~$250 device may or may not be worth picking up for you.

Buy one here: https://tinyurl.com/Retroid-RGC
Impressions video: https://youtu.be/5ATL1kX7fMQ
Android handheld starter guide: https://youtu.be/I4mqgcDYZFo
Microfiber cloth: https://amzn.to/4sVUzDN
Screen protector: https://tinyurl.com/yc6y2ern
Retroid dock: https://tinyurl.com/5ftdfwnu
Odin 2 comparison: https://youtu.be/c8bdfQENUDw

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
